accepted_delta_parts: The monotonic epoch precedes preparation imports; copied child inherits that same epoch and UTC.
The intended 865 work + 30 cleanup + 5 final readback partition stays within 900 seconds.
Grant fields bind all four timing numbers and the new v02 runner identity.
Six total role calls are explicitly shown by the new owner input check and banner; native and effect budgets remain unchanged.

findings.problem: Cooperative checks cannot interrupt a blocking preparation/import/readback call after the work cutoff. The interrupted callback only runs within supervise after control returns to its event loop.
findings.required: A reviewed nonrenewing deadline interrupt must cover preparation and active supervision, preserving the same cleanup owner and stop instant. An outer worker design must explicitly prevent orphaning its application child.

findings.problem: A success return is chosen before final guard and result persistence. Those failures are attached without changing PASS/exit status, and completed_within_absolute_envelope is recorded before final put/fsync/readback.
findings.required: Resolve exit status after bounded finalization. A final guard, persistence or deadline failure must not remain PASS. Preserve any original primary and record later failure as secondary; final completion timing must include final bounded work.

focused_control_proposal: Using an independently reviewed inert child or fake clock, cross the work deadline during copy/install and verify one primary stop and no child launch afterward.
Cross the work deadline with an active exact child, exercise a secondary exception, and prove cleanup stop instant and signal ledger are not renewed.
Inject final guard and result-write failures after apparent work success and assert nonzero STOPPED with truthful final receipt fields.
Verify an existing primary failure survives each of the same secondary failures.
Check the final hard deadline without rerunning application/native evidence; these tests grant no application semantics.
